confirmDeleteImport: Are you sure you want to delete this import configuration?
aiTranslateHelp: Automatically translates names/labels into every other enabled locale after import, using the source locale selected above
sourceLocaleHelp: The language the Name/Description text in this file is written in. Imported values are tagged to this locale instead of overwriting other locales' translations.
previewEmpty: No data found in this file.
wizardTypeHeading: What do you want to import?
wizardTypeSubtitle: Pick the kind of data in your file. The remaining steps adapt to this choice.
wizardLanguageHeading: Which language is the file written in?
wizardLanguageSubtitle: Text values (names, descriptions) are tagged to this locale and won't overwrite other languages' translations.
wizardFamilyHeading: Narrow the columns to one Attribute Family?
wizardFamilySubtitle: Picking one only shows/requires that family's own attribute columns below — it doesn't set the imported products' family. That's worked out automatically from each row's category columns (pcatname/psubcatname/productgroupname), the same way the Create/Edit product pages do it.
wizardFamilyHelp: Choose a family to narrow the columns to just its attributes and mark its required ones. Leave as "All attributes" to keep every importable field available.
wizardReviewSubtitle: Make sure your file has these columns, then download a sample to match the layout.
wizardNoRequired: This type has no strictly required columns.
wizardUploadHeading: Upload your file and check it
wizardUploadSubtitle: We'll scan the file in your browser and flag anything that would fail on import.
preflightUnknownColumns: Column(s) that don't match a known field and will be ignored: {{columns}}
preflightNoRows: The file has a header row but no data rows.
preflightRowCountCapped: Checked the first {{count}} data rows (file is larger).
preflightEmptyCells: "{{column}}" is empty in {{count}} row(s) — those rows will be skipped.
preflightDuplicateSku: {{count}} SKU value(s) appear more than once — later rows overwrite earlier ones.
preflightAllGood: No problems found — this file looks ready to import.
confirmDeleteExport: Are you sure you want to delete this export configuration?
cancelJobConfirm: Stop this job? It will finish the row it's currently on, then stop — anything already imported/exported up to that point is kept.
wooHubSubtitle: Convert product data between this catalog and your WooCommerce store, in either direction.
wooImportCardDesc: Convert a CSV exported from your WooCommerce store into the format this app's product import expects.
wooExportCardDesc: Prepare a CSV of products from this catalog in the format WooCommerce's own Products > Import expects.
wooConvertIntro: Converts a WooCommerce product-export CSV into the format this app's product import expects. The two formats don't line up field-for-field — review the result before importing, especially the category matches and any type warnings below.
wooConvertDropzoneLabel: Drag & drop your CSV here, or click to browse
wooConvertFileHelp: A .csv export from WooCommerce (Products > All Products > Export). Max 38 MB.
wooConvertFileTooLarge: This file is {{size}}, which is over the 38 MB limit. Split it into multiple files before uploading (e.g. export by category in WooCommerce).
wooConvertFamilyCodeHelp: Applied to every converted row. Leave blank if unsure — products can be assigned a family later.
wooConvertCategoryHelp: This app's category tree uses different codes/names than a WooCommerce store. Categories that can't be automatically matched by name are listed in a downloadable report after conversion — fill in the codes there and upload it back here to apply them. Once applied, each mapping is remembered permanently, so future conversions won't need that file uploaded again.
wooConvertLocaleCaveat: Product name, description, specifications, features, and included accessories are stored without a specific language assigned, since this converter has no per-language mapping. Verify they display correctly before relying on them, or leave these unchecked and set them manually.
wooConvertResultSummary: Converted "{{file}}": {{count}} row(s) ready to import, {{skipped}} row(s) skipped (no SKU).
wooConvertNewBrandsHelp: These brand names didn't have a matching option yet, so a new one was created automatically for each. Review them under Attributes > Brand if you want to rename, merge, or reorder them.
wooConvertUnmatchedHelp: Some categories could not be matched automatically. Download the report, fill in pcatname/psubcatname/productgroupname for each row, then convert again with that file as the Category Mapping — those mappings are then saved permanently, so later conversions of the same store's data resolve them automatically.
wooConvertNextStep: Once you're satisfied with the result, use the converted CSV as the file for a Products import.
wooExportIntro: Exports products from this PIM into the column shape WooCommerce's own Products > Import screen expects, for a single chosen language. Configurable products are expanded into a variable parent row plus one variation row per variant, matching WooCommerce's own format for products with options.
wooExportLocaleHelp: Which language's product name/description/specifications to export. Content still sitting in this catalog's default (not-yet-split-per-language) scope is included automatically when exporting the Thai language, since that's this catalog's original source language.
wooExportShopHelp: When a shop is selected, values set specifically for that shop (if any) are used instead of the defaults — manage shops on the Sales Platforms page.
wooExportProductsHelp: Search and pick specific products to export only those, instead of the whole catalog. Leave empty to use the filters below instead.
wooExportFiltersIgnored: Ignored while specific products are selected above.
